scale_scope: Fixed positive regular point-mass surrogate for a distant projected galaxy; not an inferred internal mass profile or material support solution.
source_plane_center: c_G = D_op theta_G - D_lp alpha_l(D_ol theta_G), evaluated on matching local conventional/R1 field; observed perturber direction is not its undeflected rear-plane center.
response: Full positive projected Plummer potential plus a jointly specified quadratic remainder at the measured rearplane. No sum of independently nonlinear scalar solutions in a common domain; no BHSM empirical interface amplitude.
